prompt:
Create one standalone vertical 9:16 WORLD_KEYFRAME showing the post-human world with absolute host isolation: no recurring host, selected host, foreground person, human figure, or character anywhere. Depict a deserted modern city corridor after humanity has vanished: empty roads with stalled vehicles, darkened power infrastructure, a subway or tunnel entrance beginning to flood, cracked pavement pushing up weeds, vines starting to climb weathered buildings, rust and water damage spreading across exposed structures, and a few wild or escaped animals cautiously reclaiming the silent streets. Suggest unattended decay and nature beginning to build over civilization, not total collapse yet.

Render entirely in cinematic rough charcoal and graphite on fibrous, weathered paper with concrete-like grain, soot bloom, rubbed graphite haze, faint water-stain mottling, expressive charcoal contours, broken architectural marks, atmospheric smudging, and selective sharper detail on decay, vegetation, animals, and machinery. Palette: desaturated storm gray, soot black, concrete beige, oxidized blue-green, dead moss green, dirty ivory, with only sparse cold amber remnants of failing artificial light. Lighting: overcast abandoned-world daylight, deep charcoal shadows, diffuse haze.

Use the recurring weathered charcoal-card frame: irregular soot-darkened outer edges, rubbed graphite corners, faint stains, and a vertically inset illustration window worn into concrete-like paper. Fill the full illustration height naturally—no caption reserve, blank strip, low-detail band, or empty panel. No readable text, letters, numbers, labels, signage emphasis, captions, UI, grid, sheet layout, or swatches. Use the world-style anchor only for medium/style continuity, never composition. NON-NEGOTIABLE EPISODE FRAME CONTRACT: Preserve this recurring frame language in this image: A recurring weathered charcoal-card frame on rough fibrous stock, with irregular soot-darkened outer edges, faint water-stain blooms, rubbed graphite corners, and a vertically inset illustration window whose boundaries feel worn into concrete-like paper. The same distressed edge grammar and charcoal vignette persist across every body image while the inner scene shifts from infrastructure failure to flooding, fire, ecological overgrowth, wildlife return, orbital decay, and long-lived ruins.. Preserve its material/edge grammar, texture, palette and inner illustration window while changing only the scene inside it. Do not reserve a lower caption field, blank strip, empty panel or low-detail band. Continue the scene and its natural texture through the full usable height, guided by the previous accepted image, without adding text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, words or UI. Binding isolation: no recurring host, no selected host, and no foreground person or character.
